label: Imaging Procedure
description: Any technology or method that aids in the visualization of any biological process, cell, tissue or organ for use in screening, diagnosis, surgical procedures or therapy.

verification.note: Schema node representing image segmentation mask information. Best NCIT match is Imaging Procedure. OBI:0003333 (computed image data set) is a closer OBI alternative.

label: Primary Key
description: The attribute selected as being most important for uniquely identifying a body of information (an entity, object or record).

verification.note: Primary Key is a direct match for a unique row identifier used as a primary key for record updates.

label: Computer Program
description: A set of coded instructions, which a computer follows in processing data, performing an operation, or solving a logical problem, upon execution of the program.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for a parameter file. Computer Program (NCIT:C17146) is the closest available match for algorithm/software configuration files. This is a partial match.

label: Number
description: A numeral or string of numerals expressing value, quantity, or identification.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for number of image objects/cells. NCIT:C25337 Number is the best available parent concept representing a count of entities. Partial match.
